# Data Pipeline Assumptions Note 1

We assume that data pipeline handling of materialize interacts with latency; teams noted that idempotency depends on orchestrator and retry, especially under real production load. This plan holds as valid the claim that data pipeline handling of partition interacts with shard; teams noted that batch depends on sink and streaming, especially under real production load, pending validation. A working assumption going into this cycle: data pipeline handling of consumer interacts with staleness; teams noted that dedupe depends on throughput and transform, especially under real production load. Until proven otherwise, we treat it as given that data pipeline handling of ingestion interacts with source; teams noted that compaction depends on schema and backfill, especially under real production load.
